Encrypted exports protect database history and durable settings with AES-256-GCM. NOOP never saves or recovers the passphrase. Credentials, hardware links, permissions, and temporary delivery state are excluded. New backups include an integrity manifest; legacy unencrypted backups still import. Restore validates and stages data before reopening the database. Cross-platform export moves supported data between Apple and Android. Folder and automatic backups are unencrypted, so use encrypted storage.
Each square is one day: red is a low day, amber middling, mint strong. An empty outline means no data; gaps stay gaps.

NOOP reads only quiet overnight windows outside recorded workouts. Movement, exercise, elevated non-resting heart rate, and noisy windows are skipped rather than interpreted. It draws the timing between heartbeats as a Poincaré scatter and computes published descriptive statistics. Rhythm is an opt-in picture of timing, never a diagnosis, and it never sends alerts.
